visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing a long blonde wig and a red-and-white ruffled dress walks through a sunlit park with green grass and tall trees. They are wearing a light grey crossbody bag and appear to be in a playful mood while walking through the dense greenery. (2) Close-up shots focus on the crossbody bag, showing its CORDURA label, zippers, and interior compartments. Hands interact with the bag, demonstrating its features while text overlays highlight the material and color options in a bright outdoor setting. (3) A character in a green cloak and a detailed witch mask with a prominent nose and chin appears behind a tree. They approach the blonde character, gesturing towards a small black tent covered in candy stickers located among the trees. (4) The blonde character holds up a small blue electronic tag and a traditional Zongzi. They follow the witch toward the 'candy house' tent. The lighting remains bright and natural, casting soft shadows on the grassy forest floor as they move. (5) The scene shifts as the character removes the blonde wig, revealing short hair and a frustrated expression. They walk away through the trees while digital flame effects appear on the screen, accompanied by large subtitles expressing anger about the filming conditions and heat.
